📖 JSONPath+ Cheatsheet

🧭 Basic Syntax

$ Root element (start every query with this)
$.store Dot notation - access child property
$['store'] Bracket notation - same as dot notation
$.store.book Chain properties with dots

📍 Array Access

[0] First element (zero-indexed)
[-1] Last element
[0,2] Elements at index 0 and 2
[0:3] Slice: elements 0, 1, 2 (end exclusive)
[::2] Every 2nd element
[*] All elements in array

🔍 Wildcards & Deep Search

* Wildcard - matches any property or element
$.store.* All children of store
.. Recursive descent - search all levels
$..name All 'name' properties anywhere in document
$..[0] First element of all arrays

🎯 Filters

[?()] Filter expression syntax
@ Current element in filter
[?(@.price)] Elements that have a 'price' property
[?(@.price > 10)] Elements where price > 10
[?(@.name == "foo")] Elements where name equals "foo"

⚖️ Comparison Operators

== Equal to
!= Not equal to
< > <= >= Less than, greater than, etc.
=~ Regex match (e.g., =~ /pattern/i)

🔗 Boolean Operators

&& Logical AND
|| Logical OR
! Logical NOT
[?(@.a && @.b)] Both conditions must be true
[?(@.a || @.b)] Either condition can be true

💡 Common Patterns

$.items[*].name Get 'name' from all items
$.items[?(@.active==true)] Filter active items
$..items[?(@.qty>5)] Find items with qty > 5 anywhere
$.data[0:5] First 5 elements of data array
Press ? anytime to open this cheatsheet
